title: Studying for a Certification Exam
paragraphs: To qualify for a promotion at work, Hana needs to pass a professional certification exam, which requires studying material she has not touched since her university years almost a decade ago.
Balancing a full-time job with evening study sessions proves exhausting, and by the third week, she considers postponing the exam to a later, less busy period of her career.
Her husband encourages her to keep her original date, offering to handle more of the household tasks temporarily so she can focus her limited evening hours entirely on studying without distraction.

On exam day, Hana passes with a comfortable margin, and reflecting afterward, she realizes that consistent short study sessions had prepared her far better than she expected during those difficult weeks.
